observations: Photo 0 shows a large, white, rectangular plastic tank with a metal grid frame and black rubber seals at the base.
The tank is resting on a wooden pallet, which is placed on a dirt ground.
The tank appears to be made of thick plastic, likely HDPE, with visible wear and dirt on the surface.
There is a watermark 'U Z GLOBAL TECHNICAL' across the center of the image.
No brand or model markings are visible on the tank or frame.
The tank is not labeled or marked with any capacity, material, or chemical compatibility information.
The seller claims it is suitable for storing acids, alkalis, and corrosive chemicals, but no such label or marking is visible.

claims.claim: The tank is suitable for storing various types of chemicals, including acids, alkalis, and corrosive...
claims.evidence: No visible markings or labels on the tank indicate its chemical compatibility or material suitability. The claim cannot be verified from the photo alone.

claims.claim: Food grade, used only once for clean water. No crack, no leak, lids complete.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The tank may not be suitable for storing corrosive chemicals as claimed.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the tank's surface or label showing chemical resistance ratings or material specifications.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unsuitable for corrosive chemicals, which reduces value for such buyers.

risks.risk: The tank may have cracks, leaks, or structural damage not visible in the photo.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the tank's seams, base, and corners, especially under lighting to reveal any cracks or bulges.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially damaged, which reduces value.

risks.risk: The tank may be made of low-quality plastic that degrades quickly when exposed to sunlight or chemicals.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the plastic surface showing texture, color, and any signs of UV degradation or brittleness.
risks.if_unproven: priced as lower-grade material, which reduces value.

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the tank's surface or label showing material type and chemical resistance.
Close-up photo of the tank's seams, base, and corners to check for cracks or damage.
Close-up photo of the plastic surface to check for UV degradation or brittleness.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
